% With tabularray, tex4ht writes no underscores for any rule in the
% document (tabularray.4ht), also after a \rule, as for the lines that
% tabularray draws with TeX rules.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tabularray}
\begin{document}
\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.4pt}

\begin{tblr}{hlines}
    a & b \\
\end{tblr}
\end{document}
